subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed minimal fix was not implemented. There is no ContentstackProvider component with useState/useEffect, no subscription to the Contentstack SDK's onEntryChange callback, and no mechanism to merge live preview updates into context state. The useContent hook (consumed by 236+ components) calls useContext(ContentstackContext) which remains a static value — live preview updates can never reach any consumer. No 'onEntryChange', 'onLiveUpdate', or 'livePreview' reference exists anywhere in src/.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a ContentstackProvider component that initializes useState with defaultContent, subscribes to the SDK's livePreview.onEntryChange callback in a useEffect, merges the incoming entry into existing content state via setContent, and wraps children with the context Provider supplying the reactive state value. Replace the bare createContext export.

issues.description: The @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency is not installed. Without this SDK, no client-side live preview subscription can be established, making real-time content updates impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Add @contentstack/live-preview-utils to package.json dependencies and import it in the ContentstackProvider to initialize live preview and subscribe to onEntryChange.

issues.description: useContent calls useContext(ContentstackContext) but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return the static SSR-provided default content and cannot propagate live preview updates to any consumer.
issues.suggestedFix: This is fixed once ContentstackProvider is implemented with reactive state — useContent will then re-render consumers when the context value changes. No change needed to the hook itself, but it depends on the Provider being wired correctly.

issues.description: While the Stack options DO include a live_preview config block (good), createContentTypeQuery and createContentTypeEntryQuery do not call query.includeFallback() or pass live_preview hash context to the Contentstack query chain. Even with the Stack configured for live preview, queries will always return published content because the live_preview hash from URL params is never forwarded to individual queries.
issues.suggestedFix: Add optional live_preview field to ICreateQueryConfig and ICreateEntryConfig interfaces, accept it in createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery, and pass it through to the Contentstack query chain. Call query.includeFallback() when live preview is active.

issues.description: ICommonContentstackConfig, ICreateQueryConfig, and ICreateEntryConfig interfaces were not updated with an optional live_preview parameter. Live preview hash data cannot flow through to Contentstack queries.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an optional live_preview field (type string or the Contentstack SDK's LivePreview type) to ICommonContentstackConfig and propagate it through ICreateQueryConfig and ICreateEntryConfig.

issues.description: No pages/api/preview.ts route exists to enable Next.js draft mode. Without this, getStaticProps will not re-run on CMS edits and the live preview session cannot be established server-side. No context.preview or context.previewData is forwarded to Contentstack service calls in any page component.
issues.suggestedFix: Create pages/api/preview.ts that calls res.setPreviewMode({}) to enable Next.js draft mode, and update getStaticProps in page components to forward context.preview/context.previewData (or the live_preview URL param) to getSingleEntry/getEntry/findSingletonEntry service calls.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. The test/unit/ directory does not exist at all. New features must have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path. At minimum, tests should verify: (1) ContentstackProvider initializes with defaultContent and updates state on onEntryChange, (2) Stack options include live_preview with enable=true and management_token, (3) useContent re-renders when context value changes. The test count has not increased.
issues.suggestedFix: Create test/unit/context/contentstackContext.test.tsx with vitest tests covering ContentstackProvider reactive behavior, onEntryChange subscription, and content merging. Create test/unit/services/contentstack.test.ts verifying live_preview config in Stack options.

issues.description: The env-check block validates CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN (good), but CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is used as the live_preview host without a presence check when live_preview is enabled. If CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is empty, live_preview will silently fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a validation check: if live_preview.enable is true, verify CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is non-empty and log an error if missing.
